_about: Staff roles and the pool of first names.

pizzaiolo.name: Pizzaiolo
pizzaiolo.desc: Makes pizzas off the ticket rail. Better trained pizzaioli portion more accurately and make better-looking pizzas.

prep.name: Prep Cook
prep.desc: Makes tomorrow’s dough at close every night and keeps the line 8% faster.

fornaio.name: Oven Tender
fornaio.desc: Loads, turns and pulls every pizza and keeps the fire fed. Bakes 10% faster.

porter.name: Kitchen Porter
porter.desc: Washes up and clears dirty tables.

headchef.name: Head Chef
headchef.desc: Lifts the quality of every pizza the brigade makes and tightens their portioning.

cashier.name: Counter Assistant
cashier.desc: Takes orders at the counter and hands over takeaways.

server.name: Server
server.desc: Seats guests, takes table orders, runs food, brings the bill, clears.

driver.name: Delivery Driver
driver.desc: Brings in delivery orders (needs a Delivery upgrade).

host.name: Host
host.desc: Seats guests the moment they arrive. More customers.

bartender.name: Bartender
bartender.desc: Runs the bar. Needed for beer taps and cocktails.

manager.name: General Manager
manager.desc: Places tomorrow's supplier orders every night to your buying standard, tops up from the cash & carry in the morning, and keeps the team 10% faster.
